# newbmiao

> newbmiao's personal blog, Devops, Terraform, Azure, Rust, Golang

- Site: https://newbmiao.github.io/
- Author: newbmiao
- Languages: English (canonical URLs) and Chinese (`*-zh.html` siblings via `lang_pair`)
- Atom feed: https://newbmiao.github.io/atom.xml
- Sitemap: https://newbmiao.github.io/sitemap.xml

## Topics

- DevOps, Azure, Terraform, authentication (OAuth2/OIDC/JWT/Keycloak)
- Open Policy Agent (Rego, bundles, policy testing)
- Rust (async, ownership, tower)
- Go (internals, concurrency, memory)
